sql_schemas: table employees | fields: id, first_name, last_name, email, role, manager_id, created_at, updated_at | pk: id | fks: manager_id -> employees.id | indexes: email: unique lookup for authentication and employee search; manager_id: frequent queries for direct reports and manager hierarchy traversal; role: RBAC filtering on employee listings

table leave_balances | fields: id, employee_id, leave_type, annual_entitlement, sick_entitlement, emergency_entitlement, annual_used, sick_used, emergency_used, year, created_at, updated_at | pk: id | fks: employee_id -> employees.id | indexes: employee_id: every balance lookup is scoped to an employee; employee_id, year, leave_type: composite lookup for balance validation during leave requests; year: archival and year-end rollover queries

table leave_requests | fields: id, employee_id, leave_type, start_date, end_date, status, reason, reviewer_id, reviewed_at, review_comment, created_at, updated_at | pk: id | fks: employee_id -> employees.id; reviewer_id -> employees.id | indexes: employee_id: all leave history queries are employee-scoped; status: filtering pending requests for manager approval queues; reviewer_id: manager dashboard showing requests awaiting their review; start_date, end_date: date-range queries for overlap detection and reporting; leave_type: filtering and aggregation by leave category

table audit_logs | fields: id, entity_type, entity_id, action, changed_by, changes, created_at | pk: id | fks: changed_by -> employees.id | indexes: entity_type, entity_id: audit trail lookups scoped to a specific record; changed_by: compliance queries filtering by actor; created_at: time-range audit scans; action: filtering audit logs by operation type (CREATE, UPDATE, DELETE, APPROVE, REJECT)

table leave_policies | fields: id, leave_type, annual_days, sick_days, emergency_days, description, is_active, created_at, updated_at | pk: id | indexes: leave_type: unique lookup for policy retrieval during balance initialization; is_active: filtering active policies for enforcement

methods: findByEmployeeYearAndType(employeeId: string, year: number, leaveType: string): Promise<LeaveBalance | null>
